You are editing JoRap notes garden frontmatter for attitude of gratitude (garden-voice skill).

## Goal
For EVERY file in the list below under `/home/jorap/Documents/GitHub/jorap.com/content/english/notes/`, ensure at least ONE of the two `examples:` lines carries a quiet earned gladness beat.

## What gratitude looks like
Good: friction + keep ("glad X caught/held/saved/taught")
BAD: "I am so grateful for this principle..."

## Rules
- ONLY edit `examples`
- Two examples, one sentence each
- No contractions (do not, it is, I am)
- No em dashes
- Prefer "glad ..." phrasing

## Files - ALL:
accept-the-starting-line.md adaptability.md behavioral-economics.md change-takes-repetition.md continuous-improvement.md create-regular-connection.md decision-quality.md deliberate-practice.md discipline.md emotional-regulation.md failure-as-feedback.md growth-mindset.md honest-self-awareness.md practice-small-experiments.md resilience.md second-order-thinking.md self-control.md standard-operating-procedures.md systems-thinking.md versatility.md

## Process
Read each, skip if already has glad/grateful/thankful/relieved, else rewrite one example line, write file.

## Return
Count skipped/edited. Do not commit.
